notes:
The pitch wheel now bends every note, two semitones either way, in every voice mode — and a note played with the wheel already pushed starts bent.
The mod wheel adds a vibrato, a third of a semitone at full travel, on top of whatever you route it to in MOD. MONO and ARP pass the wheels, the sustain pedal and aftertouch through.
Windows: the zip carries its file names in UTF-8, so the sounds named with a ² or ³ extract correctly and CYBERPUNK, LIMINAL PLAIN, OUTER HORIZON and ORANGE load as they should.
From 1.0.1: the wave and sample pickers open in place when the window is enlarged.
